canDo: Can talk for 2–3 minutes about themselves, their experience and plans, and handle follow-up questions.
review: Review the three main tenses and personal vocabulary.
input: Listen to model questions; don’t memorise whole answers.
output: A 2–3-minute recording + answering 5 follow-up questions yourself.
checkpoint: Evidence of developing information, switching tenses and answering spontaneously.
challenge: Today’s challenge: do a real self-introduction for part 1 of the DELF oral. Record 2–3 minutes on your phone, covering the present (work / studies, présent), the past (an important experience, passé composé + imparfait) and the future (plans, futur simple); on playback note 3 places where you got stuck, then watch a TV5MONDE Apprendre B1 interview, borrow 2 natural expressions and record again.

questions.why: She gives her name, age and job first, then how long she has worked and how she came to France.
The company’s requirement was the initial motive; the turning point was a three-week placement in Lyon.
She separates the two goals: B1 is a short-term administrative need; the long-term goal is to be able to chair a meeting.
The contrasting example shows that specific information leads on to follow-up.

V37-01.exZh: What led you to start learning French?

V37-02.zh: in the short term / in the longer term
V37-02.exZh: In the short term, I want to pass B1; in the longer term, to chair a meeting.

V37-03.exZh: I realised I couldn’t say anything during the breaks.

V37-04.exZh: It was that placement that made me decide to work seriously.

V37-05.exZh: I admit I started without much enthusiasm.

V37-06.exZh: I know that what I mostly lack is fluency.

V37-07.exZh: I need to take this exam for an administrative application.

V37-08.zh: an experience that made a mark on me
V37-08.exZh: I’m going to tell you about an experience that made a mark on me.

V37-09.exZh: What do you take away from it today?

V37-10.exZh: I learnt a lesson from it: speed only comes back in real situations.

V37-11.exZh: I kept the habit of listening to the tone before the content.

V37-12.zh: to go round in circles, to get restless
V37-12.exZh: After two days alone at home, I start going round in circles.

V37-13.exZh: I asked to move the meeting back an hour.

V37-14.exZh: They said no without giving a reason, and that annoys me.

V37-15.exZh: You shouldn’t learn your introduction by heart.

V37-16.exZh: An answer that’s too short forces the examiner to prompt you constantly.

V37-17.exZh: If you say you changed careers, anticipate the next question: why?

V37-18.exZh: Three people out of four are afraid of speaking in public.

V37-20.exZh: Trying to be calm fails, because you are fighting a physical reaction.

V37-21.exZh: Recording yourself is a good way to improve your speaking.

V37-22.zh: to talk about one’s path (career and life)
V37-22.exZh: When we talk about our path, we choose what we tell.

V37-23.zh: from day to day (without a long-term plan)
V37-23.exZh: A path lived from day to day is full of accidents.

V37-24.exZh: Ask someone to talk about their path: they’ll tell you a neat, ordered story.

V37-25.exZh: I had reached a decent level in 2019, then I stopped.

V37-26.exZh: After three years without practice, I took up French again.

V37-28.exZh: I come from Nanjing, in eastern China.

V37-29.exZh: I have worked as an engineer for four years.

V37-30.exZh: When I work from home, I usually go for a run at lunchtime.

V37-31.exZh: I’ve been living in France for work for eight months.

V37-32.exZh: What worked was speaking without preparation twice a week.

V37-33.exZh: My aim is to pass B1 before the end of the year.

V37-34.exZh: I’m considering staying in France after my project.

V37-35.zh: What taught me the most was …
V37-35.exZh: What taught me the most was working as a waiter while I was studying.

V37-36.exZh: In the longer term, I’d like to be able to chair a meeting in French.

V37-37.exZh: I devote a lot of time to my family.

V37-38.exZh: My colleagues say I’m very organised.

V37-39.zh: an item that doesn’t match the order
V37-39.exZh: The item I received doesn’t match my order: it’s not the model I chose.

V37-40.exZh: Could you correct this mistake on my order before it ships?

V37-41.exZh: I’d like an appointment late in the day, if possible.

V37-42.zh: passive vocabulary (words you recognise but don’t use)
V37-42.exZh: I recognised the words effortlessly: my passive vocabulary was intact.

V37-43.exZh: I would describe myself as curious and patient.

V37-44.exZh: We settled in France eight months ago.

V37-45.exZh: In my free time, I go hiking.

title: DELF speaking I: entretien dirigé
